title: Transport Services: FTL, PTL, ODC & Containers | Vidhi
description: Explore Vidhi Transport's FTL, PTL, project cargo, reverse logistics, chemical freight, ODC, port-container, warehousing and distribution services.

hero.title: The right movement for every industrial dispatch.
intro: Dedicated full truckloads, flexible part loads, reverse movement, ODC and construction cargo, port-container coordination, warehousing and distribution across Gujarat and Maharashtra.

sections.title: Nine services. One coordinated network.
intro: The right freight option depends on shipment volume, route, cargo type, handling requirements and dispatch schedule. Our operations team helps match those details to a practical movement plan.

cards.title: Full Truckload Transport
body: A dedicated vehicle for high-volume, scheduled or time-sensitive industrial consignments requiring direct movement planning.
list: Suitable for plant and warehouse dispatch

cards.title: Part Load Transport
body: Consolidated road freight for smaller and recurring industrial consignments that do not require an entire vehicle.

cards.title: Reverse Logistics
body: Coordinated return movement for rejected goods, reusable packaging and industrial materials, subject to cargo and route requirements.

cards.title: Chemical & Industrial Freight
body: Road freight coordination for packaged chemical drums, carboys, IBCs, industrial inputs, packaging, machinery and finished goods.

cards.title: First-Mile & Last-Mile Support
body: Pickup and delivery coordination between factories, warehouses, branches and final industrial destinations where operationally available.

cards.title: Project Cargo Transport
body: Planned movement of industrial machinery, equipment and multi-stage project consignments with route, lifting, site-access and schedule coordination.

cards.title: ODC & Construction Cargo
body: Movement planning for over-dimensional equipment, construction machinery, fabricated structures and project-related industrial cargo.

cards.title: Container Transport to Ports
body: Container movement coordination between industrial locations and JNPT (Nhava Sheva), Hazira and Mundra, subject to terminal conditions and vehicle availability.

cards.title: Warehousing & Distribution
body: Practical warehousing, consolidation, inventory staging and onward distribution for accepted packaged industrial goods.
list: Inward receipt and agreed storage support

sections.title: Billing and delivery options built around your process.
intro: Choose an agreed freight-payment method and delivery arrangement to match your purchase, dispatch and consignee process.

cards.title: Freight payment & billing
body: Select the commercial arrangement agreed for your shipment or customer account.

cards.title: Delivery arrangements
body: Plan pickup and delivery around factory, branch, godown and consignee requirements.

cards.title: Controlled delivery options
body: Use consignee-document or collection instructions where they are agreed in advance.

Need a combination? Options can be combined—for example, To Pay with Door-to-Door delivery or Account Billing with DACC—subject to customer agreement, cargo, route, documentation and operational confirmation.

sections.title: The right service starts with the right details.
intro: Share the route, cargo description, approximate weight, packaging, dimensions where relevant, and preferred dispatch date. Our operations team will suggest the most practical next step.

cards.title: Route & coverage
body: Pickup, destination and branch availability determine the movement plan.

cards.title: Cargo & handling
body: Material type, packaging and documentation guide cargo coordination.

cards.title: Volume & timing
body: Shipment size and dispatch urgency help determine whether FTL or PTL fits best.
